exposure: Support to breastfeeding (by professionals and family members)
Mother's stay for a longer period with the child
outcome: Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) for up to six months
cohort: The study included 101 mother/infant binomials cared for at a usual-risk Public Maternity Hospital in Curitiba, state of Parana, Brazil.
finding: Support to breastfeeding by professionals and family members increased 4-fold the chance of maintaining exclusive breastfeeding.
